precomputed_policy: Complete or governed-unavailable results are retained. Incomplete public results/transition metadata use the already-approved calculator, with a trace of the original record hash. No bank rows are modified.
timestamp_policy: local remains Date.parse-compatible and represents the event UTC instant to whole-second precision. local_exact carries the runtime IANA civil clock and exact offset seconds. Displays prefer local_exact; comparisons use utc.
star_policy: Day-context Nakshatra near a sunrise boundary, or a birth minute intersecting the 60-second review band, produces a precision-review notice without exact Nakshatra or generated reflection. Existing reflective bank remains unchanged.
timezone_scope: Historical rules continue to use the existing runtime Intl/IANA provider. Exact formatting is not independent certification of historical timezone/backzone data.
